program: Food Assistance Program (FAP) — Michigan's name for SNAP
agency: Michigan Department of Health and Human Services (MDHHS)
admin_note: State-administered: MDHHS runs FAP directly through local offices; there are no independent county eligibility agencies. Policy lives in the Bridges Eligibility Manual (BEM) and Bridges Administrative Manual (BAM), amended by numbered Bulletins (BPB — Bridges Policy Bulletin); dollar tables live separately in the Reference Tables Manual (RFT), amended by Reference Table Bulletins (RFB). Bridges is both MDHHS's eligibility system and the name lending itself to the manuals.

update_channels.name: Bridges Eligibility Manual (BEM) + Bridges Administrative Manual (BAM), amended by BPB bulletins
Reference Tables Manual (RFT), amended by RFB bulletins — annual FY dollar tables

verification.method: Direct fetch of ~35 BEM/BAM/RFT PDFs + the BPG Glossary over plain curl (dhhs.michigan.gov/OLMWEB — stable per-document URLs, no host blocking observed) + MCL 400.10b (legislature.mi.gov) → cross-read against the FNS BBCE chart and framework roster entry → draft → adversarial refute gate.
verification.gates: Cross-check: every pivotal dollar value and eligibility rule traced to its own PDF page image (not a curated extract) before drafting. Refute gate recorded in PROVENANCE.md.
sources: MCL 400.10b, Social Welfare Act 280 of 1939 (legislature.mi.gov) — felony-warrant disqualification statute
